concepts.name: Split-Stack Architecture
concepts.description: React frontend on Vercel, FastAPI backend on Railway, MongoDB on Atlas - complete separation of concerns

concepts.name: Live-Only Data Policy
concepts.description: Tilastokeskus removed, no synthetic/interpolated/extrapolated data anywhere - only real scrapes from polttoaine.net and tankille.fi

concepts.name: Security Hardening
concepts.description: 9 critical vulnerabilities fixed: credential exposure, authentication, rate limiting, CORS tightening, XML entity protection, dependency patching

concepts.name: Accuracy Improvements
concepts.description: Anchor/target alignment, region validation, IQR-based sanity filter, consistent price parsing - expected 15-25% MAE improvement

concepts.name: Finnish Language UI
concepts.description: All user-facing text in Finnish, dark theme by default, no-FOUC localStorage persistence

concepts.name: Scheduled Captures
concepts.description: Automated price captures at 14:00 and 21:00 Helsinki time via tracker.scheduler_loop

concepts.name: Data-Quality-Aware Ensemble
concepts.description: 5 methods (MA, LR, ES, fundamental_anchor, AI) with weights adjusted based on data thickness, clamped ±0.06 EUR/L from live anchor

concepts.name: Fundamental Anchor Method
concepts.description: Live price + Brent-EUR pass-through + weekday prior + momentum - new prediction method emphasizing live data

concepts.name: Geopolitical Risk Handling
concepts.description: AI system message with 9 uncalibrated priors, conflict keyword scanning, forward risk assessment without double-counting Brent-priced risk

concepts.name: Git Worktree Development
concepts.description: Multiple parallel development branches via .claude/worktrees for agent tasks and feature branches

concepts.name: Zero Personal Data Collection
concepts.description: No user accounts, no cookies, no analytics, no tracking - only localStorage theme preference

concepts.name: Admin Token Authentication
concepts.description: Constant-time comparison of X-Admin-Token header or password field to protect destructive endpoints

concepts.name: Rate Limiting Strategy
concepts.description: 10-20 requests/minute on expensive endpoints (/api/predict/run, /api/track/run-all) to prevent DoS

concepts.name: Price Sanity Filtering
concepts.description: Hard bounds 1.10-3.50 EUR/L, IQR-based outlier detection (1.5×IQR rule), won't drop genuinely cheapest stations

concepts.name: Data Source Priority
concepts.description: tankille.fi PRIMARY (user-tested as more accurate), polttoaine.net SECONDARY (cross-check), fallback if >10% difference

concepts.name: Per-City Tracking
concepts.description: daily_tracker.by_city stores {cheapest, average, count, station, source} for Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Tampere, Turku, Lahti

concepts.name: Deployment Checklist
concepts.description: Step-by-step post-fix actions: set ADMIN_TOKEN, test auth/rate-limiting/region-validation, monitor logs for credential leaks

concepts.name: Cold Start Tolerance
concepts.description: Prediction methods work with 0-N daily points, graceful degradation, no hard gates blocking methods

concepts.name: News-Watcher Auto-Rerun
concepts.description: Monitors RSS feeds, auto-reruns AI prediction when fuel-relevant news changes (rate-limited, 15+ min gap)

concepts.name: CRA Build-Time Environment Variables
concepts.description: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL baked at build time - requires Vercel redeploy on change
